reallife.overlay.title: Real Life Stats
reallife.wiki.title: Real Life Mod Guide
reallife.wiki.page0:
Welcome to Real Life Mod!

Your body now has stats:
- Strength: Physical power.
- Endurance: Fatigue resistance.
- Lung Capacity: Stamina regen.
- Stamina: Energy for running/fighting.

Monitor them on the left overlay!
reallife.wiki.page1:
NEEDS:

- Thirst: Drink water. Dehydration causes weakness.
- Temperature: Dress for the biome. Extremes hurt immunity.
- Nutrition: 
  Protein -> Muscle Growth.
  Carbs -> Energy Regen.
reallife.wiki.page2:
MEDICAL:

- Bleeding: Use Bandage.
- Broken Leg: Use Splint.
- Sickness: Use Antibiotics.

Don't fall from heights and avoid thorny plants!
reallife.wiki.page3:
TRAINING:

- Treadmill: Trains Lungs.
- Bench Press: Trains Strength (requires energy).
- Dumbbell: Portable training.

Genetics: You are born with a trait (Athlete, Runner, etc).
reallife.wiki.page4:
HARDCORE:

- Sanity: Stay in light. Dark causes hallucinations.
- Fatigue: Sleep or drink Energy Drinks.
- Hygiene: Wash with Soap or in water to avoid attracting mobs.
